triggers.notes: Fires once the transports have begun their run to shore (v0.38 naval).
Scout sights raiders to the south.

slides.text: Caesar's will: cross the sea and plant the eagle on the great island.
The legion embarks at dawn. Hold the beachhead and build.
The colony grows. Rome's grain and trade take root on the island.
Smoke to the south — raiders mass against our young colony.
The island is Rome's. Mare Nostrum — our sea — is whole.
The transports ground on the western shore. The legion wades onto the island.

rpg_requests.request_text: Caesar asks 500 gold to fund the southern wall. Pay now, next month, or refuse?

events.name: Southern Raiders
events.message: Raiders strike from the arid south!

events.name: Caesar's Wrath
events.message: Caesar is displeased with your defiance.
